examples.title: September kiln workbook was truncated
examples.body: The main kiln file for September could not be opened (three-quarters of it was empty bytes), so September is left out rather than guessed.

examples.title: An April file was a copy of May
examples.body: One April workbook repeated May's readings minute for minute. It was caught and excluded before any modelling.

examples.title: A 10-hour frozen window across 122 tags
examples.body: On 6 May, 11:50–21:50, many unrelated readings stopped changing at once, a sign of a held export. Those minutes are masked.

examples.title: '99999' placeholder values in 35 columns
examples.body: Historian placeholders were treated as missing, not as real readings, so they never distort the baseline.

examples.title: 4,135 duplicate timestamps
examples.body: Rows that repeat the same minute were resolved before analysis so each minute counts once.

asks.title: Kiln event logs, Apr–Sep 2025
asks.detail: Timestamped coating, ring, cleaning, maintenance and stoppage records, with reasons.
asks.unlocks: Matching abnormal periods to real events, and calibrating early warning (Stage 2).

asks.title: Kiln-inlet O₂ analyser calibration and purge schedule
asks.detail: When the analyser was purged, calibrated or reading ambient air.
asks.unlocks: Separating real process drift from instrument effects in the August rise.

asks.title: Alternative-fuel quality logs
asks.detail: Calorific value, moisture, RDF / plastic split, chlorine and ash, with sample times.

asks.title: Alternative-fuel operating log
asks.detail: Why AFR feed was started, stopped or ramped (feeder trips, stock-outs, operator decisions).
asks.unlocks: Separating operator actions from process responses.

asks.title: Missing workbooks
asks.detail: A re-export of the main kiln log for September 2025 and of the April 2025 file that duplicated May.
asks.unlocks: A full six months of history instead of five.

asks.title: Tag and definition confirmations
asks.detail: Whether the ten folders are pages of one kiln line, what 'Kiln MD' means, and which specific-heat tag is authoritative.
asks.unlocks: A firmer baseline and efficiency index.
